subtitle: Cross-check of 16/Oct/2026, 12th day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, the seventeen national polls conducted after the vote, including CNT/MDA, Futura/100% Cidades and PoderData/Aya of 16/Oct and Datafolha, Palver and Indexa of 15/Oct, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 15 and 16/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 23.50% (cumulative volume USD 25.11M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, rising 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 15/Oct at 17:37 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT BOX: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 45.9% to 46.8% in CNT/MDA and 47.5% to 49% in Futura/100% Cidades of 16/Oct, a tie at 50% of the valid votes in PoderData/Aya; ahead only in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, 44.2% to 42.7%.
fortes: He leads Vox Brasil of 09/Oct by 44.2% to 42.7%, within the margin of 2.15 points, and has 50.86% of the valid votes.

In PoderData/Aya, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro in valid votes falls from 6 points in the 05 to 07/Oct wave to zero in the 13 to 15/Oct wave; in Futura/100% Cidades, from 3.4 points to 1.5 in total votes between the 13 and 16/Oct waves, and in Datafolha from 4 to 2 between the 06 to 08/Oct and 13 to 15/Oct waves.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 25.11M.
fracos: He stands at 23.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 52.95pp.

He trails in fifteen of the seventeen national polls conducted after the vote: 45.9% to 46.8% in CNT/MDA and 47.5% to 49% in Futura/100% Cidades of 16/Oct, 45% to 47% in Datafolha, 49% to 50% in Palver and 42% to 44% in Indexa of 15/Oct and 44% to 46% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 23.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 25.11M), confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, and rises 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 15/Oct at 17:37 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 In CNT/MDA of 16/Oct he has 45.9% against 46.8%, after 47.3% to 43.1% in the 03/Oct wave; in Futura/100% Cidades he has 47.5% against 49%, after 46.6% to 50% on 13/Oct, and in PoderData/Aya he ties at 50% of the valid votes. On 15/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 47% to 45%, Palver 50% to 49% and Indexa 44% to 42%; [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct gave 46% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. After the promulgation, Lula said the 6x1 work schedule will return if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the election (O Globo and Valor), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ On 16/Oct the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) plenary unanimously approved, with André Mendonça as rapporteur, rules that link to the campaigns the WhatsApp and other platform channels that receive money, technical support or guidance from them, with mandatory registration (Gazeta do Povo and G1), and Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva denied the Flávio Bolsonaro campaign's request to restrict the activity of unions and students on social media (CartaCapital, G1 and Estadão). On 15/Oct the court had unanimously struck down the 48-hour wait to reactivate channels registered after the deadline and ordered the removal of videos by the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira that link Lula to the alleged [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds (Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and G1). In a statement on 16/Oct, Meta attributed to a gap in its safeguards the fact that its AI produced campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and not for Lula, said the problem had been fixed and denied interfering in the election (O Globo); in internal messages, the company admitted that Lula's accounts were harmed by restrictions (Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 76.45% (cumulative volume USD 21.23M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, down 0.80pp against the confirmed reading of 15/Oct at 17:37 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT BOX: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 46.8% to 45.9% in CNT/MDA and 49% to 47.5% in Futura/100% Cidades of 16/Oct, a tie at 50% of the valid votes in PoderData/Aya; ahead in fifteen of the seventeen post-vote national polls.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 76.45% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT.

He leads fifteen of the seventeen national polls conducted after the vote: 46.8% to 45.9% in CNT/MDA and 49% to 47.5% in Futura/100% Cidades of 16/Oct, 47% to 45% in Datafolha, 50% to 49% in Palver and 44% to 42% in Indexa of 15/Oct and 46% to 44% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, with 42.7% against 44.2%, and ties at 50% of the valid votes in PoderData/Aya of 16/Oct, after 53% to 47% in the 05 to 07/Oct wave; in Futura/100% Cidades his lead narrows from 3.4 points to 1.5 in total votes between the 13 and 16/Oct waves, and in Datafolha from 4 to 2 between the 06 to 08/Oct and 13 to 15/Oct waves.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 76.45% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 21.23M), confirmed reading of 16/Oct, 17:01 BRT, and falls 0.80pp against the confirmed reading of 15/Oct at 17:37 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Three national polls came out on 16/Oct. CNT/MDA, with 2,002 in-person interviews from 13 to 15/Oct, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 46.8% and Lula 45.9% in the prompted question, with 4.9% blank and null votes and 2.4% undecided, and 50.5% to 49.5% in valid votes; in the 03/Oct wave, on the eve of the first round, the pollster's second-round scenario gave Lula 47.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro 43.1% (Metrópoles and Gazeta do Povo). Futura/100% Cidades, with 2,000 phone interviews on 14 and 15/Oct, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 47.5% in total votes and 50.8% to 49.2% in valid votes; in the 13/Oct wave it was 50% to 46.6% in total votes (Poder360, CNN Brasil and Money Times). PoderData/Aya, with 3,000 phone interviews from 13 to 15/Oct, measures 50% to 50% in valid votes and does not publish total votes; in valid votes it was 51% to 49% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 10 to 12/Oct wave and 53% to 47% in the 05 to 07/Oct wave (Poder360). On 15/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 47% to 45%, Palver 50% to 49% and Indexa 44% to 42%; [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct gave 46% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1). On 16/Oct, former Fortaleza mayor Roberto Cláudio, who ran in the first round as Ciro Gomes's running mate in Ceará, declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro; Ciro has not commented (G1). Renan Santos said on 15/Oct that he sees a greater danger of concentration of power in a Flávio Bolsonaro victory, but that he does not back Lula and will not vote (O Globo and Estadão). On 16/Oct Congress promulgated the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule, which cuts the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours, in a ceremony with Lula and the Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta, and without opposition senators; the Senate approved it on the night of 14/Oct by 75 votes to 1 in both rounds of voting, with Hamilton Mourão voting against (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor). Flávio Bolsonaro had said on 13/Oct that he would vote in favour, and he will attend the Band debate on 18/Oct after having said he would not (UOL, CartaCapital and CNN Brasil). ⚖️ On 16/Oct the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) plenary unanimously approved, with André Mendonça as rapporteur, rules that link to the campaigns the WhatsApp and other platform channels that receive money, technical support or guidance from them, with mandatory registration (Gazeta do Povo and G1), and Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva denied the Flávio Bolsonaro campaign's request to restrict the activity of unions and students on social media (CartaCapital, G1 and Estadão). On 15/Oct the court had unanimously struck down the 48-hour wait to reactivate channels registered after the deadline and ordered the removal of videos by the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira that link Lula to the alleged [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds (Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and G1). In a statement on 16/Oct, Meta attributed to a gap in its safeguards the fact that its AI produced campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and not for Lula, said the problem had been fixed and denied interfering in the election (O Globo); in internal messages, the company admitted that Lula's accounts were harmed by restrictions (Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

Lula gave an interview to Jornal Nacional on the night of 15/Oct, and Flávio Bolsonaro's is scheduled for the night of 16/Oct (UOL, Congresso em Foco, G1 and Valor). 📊 The next national polls registered with the TSE come out on 17/Oct (Veritá and Ipespe), 18/Oct (Vox Brasil and Phoenix), 19/Oct (AtlasIntel, PoderData, BTG/Nexus, DataTrends and 100 Cidades), 20/Oct (Veritá and Alfa) and 21/Oct (Quaest, Palver, Gerp, 100 Cidades and Ideia). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the polls, the endorsements or the day's acts: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
